question: Should ClawHub add a first-class SKILL.md capability manifest for skills, and what schema, authority model, and advisory-to-required rollout should it use?
rationale: This changes the skill trust boundary and public security contract; source inspection can show it is not implemented, but automation cannot choose the permanent schema or rollout policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Advisory manifest first
options.body: Define the capability schema in specs, parse and expose it as advisory metadata, and let ClawScan flag declared-versus-observed mismatches before making it required.

options.title: Defer to scanner inference
options.body: Keep using env/install metadata plus ClawScan coherence review, accepting that there is no author-declared baseline for network, filesystem, execution, or secret access yet.

options.title: Require manifests immediately
options.body: Make new submissions provide the capability block from day one, which gives a stronger contract but requires a sharper legacy and false-positive policy before rollout.

recommendation.title: Advisory manifest first
recommendation.body: Define the capability schema in specs, parse and expose it as advisory metadata, and let ClawScan flag declared-versus-observed mismatches before making it required.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses CODEOWNERS-listed schema, moderation, scanner, and security documentation paths where this handle is the strongest routing signal.
